{{Top|leg}}
A '''Simple Home''' was communal housing used by the Followers of the [[Cosmic Balance]]. They were the residences of the [[ascetic]]s, those siblings who had been given the [[Bowl]] and committed to a life of servitude. While their sibling prospered in this life, the ascetics expected to reap the rewards in the afterlife, known as the "[[Life To Come]]."

Simple Homes were overseeing by the [[Zanazi]] with the help of [[Home Mother]]s and [[Home Father]]s. Male and female ascetics were house separately, and Simple Homes depended on contributions from the Followers of the Cosmic Balance.
